summary: The study compares two fabricated MXene electrodes: unmodified LiF/HCl-etched Ti3C2Tx and Ti3C2Tx@C, a Zn2+-crosslinked, GA-derived carbon-dot-intercalated porous aerogel. Ti3C2Tx@C is the headline electrode and reaches its highest reported gravimetric capacitance of 436 F g-1 at 1 A g-1; it also gives 393.7 F g-1 at 2 mV s-1. The Ti3C2Tx control reaches 315.5 F g-1 at 2 mV s-1. No electrode thickness, porosity percentage, lateral flake size, or volumetric/areal capacitance was reported.
